topic.source_contract: Waste hierarchy, waste-planning need and site selection, environmental permits, operator competence and public-register evidence

facts.planning: waste hierarchy is relevant to local plans and decisions
facts.guard: hierarchy compliance is not site permission or permit

facts.policy: need, suitable sites, determination and monitoring framework
facts.guard: policy allocation is not planning permission

facts.permit: application route for activities including waste storage and treatment
facts.guard: application is not a granted permit

facts.scope: waste use, recycling, treatment, storage and disposal permitting
facts.guard: planning permission and environmental permit are separate

facts.register: public register of permitted waste operations
facts.guard: register entry must match operator, site, activity and current status

scope_guards: A waste-plan allocation is not treated as planning permission.
Planning permission is not treated as an environmental permit.
A permit application is not treated as a granted and effective permit.
A public-register match is not accepted without exact operator, site and activity alignment.
A waste exemption is not treated as a permit or planning approval.
Recovery and disposal classifications are not conflated.
Permit capacity is not treated as constructed or operational throughput.
No score or promotion is written without exact site, planning status, permit, operator competence, infrastructure and operational evidence.
